intent.raw_query: Thailand beaches, $1800 for couple, mix of island hopping and street food, October 2026

experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
experiences.description: Embark on a full-day speedboat tour around the stunning Phi Phi archipelago, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters at Maya Bay, exploring Viking Cave, and swimming at Monkey Beach. One of Thailand's most iconic island-hopping experiences with breathtaking limestone karst scenery.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Market Tour
experiences.description: Dive into Bangkok's legendary street food scene at Yaowarat Road (Chinatown), sampling pad thai, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, boat noodles, and fresh seafood. Join a guided walking tour or explore independently through the bustling night stalls and hawker carts for an authentic culinary adventure.

experiences.name: Railay Beach Rock Climbing & Sunset
experiences.description: Accessible only by longtail boat, Railay Beach offers world-class limestone rock climbing for all skill levels with certified guides. After your climb, relax on the powdery white sand and watch a spectacular Andaman Sea sunset. The dramatic karst cliffs and turquoise waters make this one of Thailand's most photogenic spots.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta & Koh Rok Island Hopping by Catamaran
experiences.description: Sail aboard a catamaran from Koh Lanta to the remote, pristine Koh Rok islands, known for their untouched coral reefs, vibrant marine life, and impossibly clear turquoise waters. Snorkel among sea turtles and tropical fish, enjoy a beachside lunch, and experience some of the least crowded paradise islands in southern Thailand.
experiences.location: Koh Lanta & Koh Rok, Krabi Province

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Street Food & Night Bazaar Experience
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant Saturday or Sunday Walking Street and the famous Night Bazaar in Chiang Mai's Old City, feasting on northern Thai specialties like khao soi (coconut curry noodles), sai oua (herbed sausage), and crispy pork rinds. Wander through hundreds of stalls offering local crafts, live music, and authentic regional dishes rarely found in tourist restaurants.
experiences.location: Wualai Road & Night Bazaar, Chiang Mai Old City

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Thailand
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage, and arrange budget airport transfer (Airport Rail Link to city center ~45 THB, then taxi/bus to accommodation). Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort and freshen up.

meals.breakfast: N/A - in transit
meals.lunch: N/A - in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack from a 7-Eleven or airport food court (~80-120 THB) before heading to the resort

day_by_day.notes: Exchange a small amount of currency at the airport (rates are decent at Superrich kiosks). Get a local SIM card at the airport for ~300 THB with data. Keep receipts for your budget tracking. October is shoulder/rainy season so pack a light rain jacket.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from jet lag. After a late breakfast, take a leisurely walk along the beachfront near Aegean Bliss Resort. Explore the immediate surroundings, locate nearby convenience stores, ATMs, and street food stalls. Dip your toes in the water and get oriented.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a bicycle or scooter (~150-200 THB/day) from a local shop near the resort. Explore the local beach town, visit the nearest fresh market, and pick up any essentials. Visit a nearby temple or local landmark to soak in the Thai culture. Browse local shops for cheap beach gear if needed.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the nearest night market or beach promenade for dinner. Try classic Thai street food dishes like Pad Thai, Som Tum (papaya salad), and grilled skewers. Enjoy a Chang or Leo beer from a beach bar while watching the sunset.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or nearby cafe with Thai-style breakfast: rice porridge (jok) or toast with eggs (~80-120 THB)
meals.lunch: Street food stall near the market: Khao Man Gai (chicken rice) or noodle soup (~50-80 THB)
meals.dinner: Night market street food spread: Pad Thai, grilled corn, mango sticky rice (~150-200 THB total)

day_by_day.notes: Stay hydrated — October can be hot and humid. Always carry a reusable water bottle. Budget tip: buy large water bottles from 7-Eleven (~15 THB) rather than tourist shops. Confirm scooter rental includes a helmet.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise beach walk. Head to the local pier or ferry terminal to book a budget island-hopping day tour (~600-900 THB per person). Many operators offer group tours that include snorkeling, beach stops, and lunch. Confirm the next day's tour while you're there.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the main beach near the resort. Rent a snorkel set (~100 THB) from a beachside vendor and explore the shallow reef. Alternatively, visit a nearby viewpoint or cliff for panoramic ocean views. Look for free or low-cost attractions like local fishing villages.
day_by_day.evening: Find a local Thai restaurant (not on the tourist strip) for an authentic and affordable dinner. Try Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) and a green curry. Walk the beach promenade after dinner and enjoy the atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit from a street vendor and a Thai iced coffee (~60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Beachside food stall: fried rice or stir-fried noodles with vegetables (~70-100 THB)
meals.dinner: Local Thai restaurant off the main tourist street: 2-3 shared dishes with rice (~150-200 THB per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book your island-hopping tour directly with local operators at the pier rather than through hotel concierge to save 20-30%. Always negotiate prices politely. Check weather forecast for the next few days as October can bring rain squalls.

day_by_day.morning: Early start for a full-day budget island-hopping tour. Depart from the local pier around 8:00-9:00 AM. Visit 2-3 nearby islands, enjoy snorkeling at coral reefs, and swim in crystal-clear lagoons. Most group tours include basic snorkeling equipment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island-hopping tour with a beach BBQ or included lunch on one of the islands. Explore hidden coves, collect shells, and relax on pristine beaches. Take plenty of photos of the stunning Thai island scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the mainland pier by late afternoon (around 17:00). Head back to the resort to shower and change. Celebrate a great day with a beachfront dinner and fresh seafood from a local vendor.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast before the tour: banana pancake from a street stall (~40-60 THB)
meals.lunch: Included in the island-hopping tour, or pack snacks from 7-Eleven if not included (~50-100 THB backup budget)
meals.dinner: Fresh seafood grilled at a beachside shack: whole fish, prawns, or squid with rice (~200-300 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Bring reef-safe sunscreen (important for marine conservation), a dry bag for your phone and valuables, and plenty of water. Tip your boat crew if you enjoyed the tour (~50-100 THB). October seas can be choppy — take seasickness tablets if prone.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning after the active day. Enjoy a slow breakfast and explore the local area on foot. Visit a nearby Buddhist temple (wat) for a cultural experience — most are free to enter (dress respectfully: cover shoulders and knees). Pick up a temple blessing bracelet as a souvenir.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a local songthaew (shared taxi truck, ~30-50 THB) to a different beach or bay in the area. Many Thai islands and coastal towns have multiple beaches with different vibes. Explore a quieter, less-touristy beach for an authentic experience. Try stand-up paddleboarding (~200 THB/hour) if available.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the main town for a street food crawl. Sample as many different dishes as possible: spring rolls, satay skewers, coconut ice cream, fried banana, and fresh coconut water. Visit a local bar for cheap happy hour drinks (beer from ~60 THB).

meals.breakfast: Resort or guesthouse breakfast: eggs, toast, fresh fruit, and coffee (~100-150 THB)
meals.lunch: Beachside coconut curry or stir-fry from a local vendor (~80-120 THB)
meals.dinner: Street food crawl budget: sample 5-6 different items (~200-250 THB total)

day_by_day.notes: When visiting temples, always remove shoes before entering. A sarong (~50-100 THB) is useful to cover up at temples and can double as a beach wrap. Budget tip: coconut water straight from the coconut at the beach costs ~30-50 THB and is very refreshing.

day_by_day.morning: Head to the local market early in the morning (most open around 6:00-8:00 AM) for a true local experience. Browse fresh produce, local snacks, and cheap souvenirs. Practice bargaining politely — start at 50-60% of the asking price. Pick up local spices, dried fruits, or handicrafts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a budget longtail boat tour (~300-500 THB for a private charter, or join a group) to explore nearby sea caves, mangroves, or hidden lagoons. Many coastal areas in Thailand have stunning limestone karst formations accessible only by boat. Bring a waterproof camera or phone case.
day_by_day.evening: Cook your own meal if your accommodation has kitchen facilities, using ingredients from the morning market. Alternatively, join a budget Thai cooking class (~600-900 THB) offered by many guesthouses — you'll learn to make 3-4 dishes and eat your creations.

meals.breakfast: Fresh market breakfast: sticky rice with mango or grilled pork skewers (~50-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Pack market snacks for the boat tour or grab a quick noodle soup near the pier (~60-80 THB)
meals.dinner: Home-cooked Thai meal from market ingredients (~100-150 THB) or cooking class meal (included in class fee)

day_by_day.notes: If taking a cooking class, book in advance as popular classes fill up quickly. The skills you learn will save money on future travels. Keep an eye on the weather — if a storm is approaching, the longtail boat tour may be cancelled for safety.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning ferry or speedboat to a nearby island for a day trip. Popular options in Thailand include smaller, less-developed islands that offer pristine beaches without the crowds. Purchase a return ferry ticket (~200-400 THB round trip) and spend the day exploring.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the island on foot or by renting a bicycle (~100-150 THB/day). Visit the best beaches, snorkel spots, and viewpoints. Pack your own snacks and water from the mainland to save money. Find a shady spot for a midday rest during the hottest hours (12:00-14:00).
day_by_day.evening: Return ferry to the mainland before sunset. Freshen up at the resort and head out for a sunset dinner. Try a new Thai dish you haven't tried yet — Massaman curry, Pad See Ew, or Khao Pad (fried rice) with seafood. End the evening with a traditional Thai massage (~200-300 THB/hour).

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast before the ferry: rice soup or congee from a street stall (~60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Simple island lunch at a local beach shack: grilled fish with rice and vegetables (~120-180 THB)
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant: Thai curry and rice with a fresh fruit shake (~150-200 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Check the ferry schedule carefully — last boats back to the mainland are often around 17:00-18:00 and missing it means an unplanned overnight stay. A traditional Thai massage is a must-try budget luxury — avoid fancy spa chains and opt for local massage shops.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip — take a relaxed morning. Do laundry at a local laundromat (~60-100 THB per load, wash and fold service available) to refresh your travel wardrobe. Review your budget spending so far and adjust if needed. Update a travel journal or photo album.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local town more deeply. Visit a local market, browse cheap souvenir shops for gifts (avoid the tourist-priced shops near the beach — venture 2-3 streets inland for better prices). Visit a local café for iced coffee and people-watching.
day_by_day.evening: Join a free or low-cost beach bonfire or social event — many budget guesthouses and beach bars organize these. Meet fellow travelers, share tips, and enjoy the relaxed Thai beach atmosphere. Try a bucket cocktail (a Thai beach staple, ~150-200 THB) responsibly.

meals.breakfast: Sleep in and have a late brunch: American breakfast or Thai omelet from a cafe (~100-150 THB)
meals.lunch: Local noodle shop: boat noodles (kuay teow reua) — tiny bowls, order 3-4 for a full meal (~80-120 THB total)
meals.dinner: Casual beach bar dinner: burgers or Thai food with a drink (~150-200 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Halfway through the trip — reassess your budget. If overspending, cut back on tours and focus on free beach activities. If under budget, consider splurging on a nicer dinner or an extra boat trip. Stay aware of your belongings in crowded night market areas.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a kayaking adventure. Rent a sea kayak (~200-300 THB for 2 hours) and paddle along the coastline, exploring hidden beaches and sea caves accessible only by kayak. This is one of the best budget activities in Thailand offering stunning scenery at low cost.
day_by_day.afternoon: After kayaking, relax on the beach and try some local beach snacks from vendors. Participate in a free beach volleyball game if available. Take a late afternoon swim and watch the fishing boats return to shore — a beautiful and authentic Thai scene.
day_by_day.evening: Explore a different area of the local town for dinner. Find a family-run Thai restaurant where locals eat — the food will be more authentic and cheaper than tourist restaurants. Order a few dishes to share. After dinner, visit a night market for dessert and browsing.

meals.breakfast: Energy breakfast before kayaking: peanut butter toast and banana from a 7-Eleven (~50-70 THB)
meals.lunch: Beach vendor food: fresh fruit platter, grilled corn, and coconut water (~100-130 THB)
meals.dinner: Family-run Thai restaurant: 3 dishes shared + rice + soft drinks (~120-160 THB per person)

day_by_day.notes: When kayaking, always wear a life jacket and check weather conditions. Don't kayak during heavy rain or strong winds. Tip: paddling early morning (7:00-9:00 AM) offers the calmest seas and most beautiful light for photos.

day_by_day.morning: Book a budget snorkeling trip to a coral reef or marine national park in the area (~400-700 THB including equipment and park fees). Many budget operators offer morning trips that return by noon. Look for trips that visit multiple snorkeling spots for maximum value.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the snorkeling trip, visit a local waterfall or nature trail if available in the area. Many Thai coastal regions have inland waterfalls within 30-60 minutes by scooter. Entrance fees are usually minimal (~20-50 THB). Swim in the natural pool at the base of the waterfall.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourself to a slightly nicer dinner to celebrate the penultimate stretch of the trip. Choose a well-reviewed local seafood restaurant and try whole grilled barramundi or tiger prawns. Share a seafood platter for two if traveling with a companion.

meals.breakfast: Pre-tour breakfast: Thai-style omelet with rice and green tea (~70-100 THB)
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling lunch at a pier restaurant: fish and chips or Thai fried rice (~120-160 THB)
meals.dinner: Seafood dinner splurge: whole grilled fish, seafood stir-fry, rice, and dessert (~250-350 THB per person)

day_by_day.notes: When snorkeling, never touch or stand on coral — it's illegal in marine parks and damages the ecosystem. Apply sunscreen 30 minutes before entering the water and use reef-safe brands. The waterfall may have reduced flow in October depending on rainfall.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to souvenir shopping on a budget. Head to the local market and less-touristy shops for the best deals on: Thai silk scarves, elephant pants, ceramic goods, spices, and local artwork. Bargain confidently but respectfully. Budget ~500-800 THB for gifts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a final island or beach exploration trip. Hire a longtail boat for a private 2-hour sunset cruise (~500-700 THB split between 2-4 people). Visit one last hidden beach or snorkel spot you haven't seen yet. Take in the beauty of the Thai coastline one more time.
day_by_day.evening: Final big night out at the local night market. Do a complete street food tour — try everything you haven't eaten yet: crispy pork belly, Thai crepes (roti), spicy papaya salad, fresh spring rolls, and coconut ice cream in a coconut shell. Enjoy live music if available.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl or fresh fruit shake from a health cafe (~80-120 THB)
meals.lunch: Quick street food lunch while shopping: grilled pork rice or noodle soup (~60-80 THB)
meals.dinner: Final night market feast: unlimited street food sampling (~200-300 THB)

day_by_day.notes: When bargaining for souvenirs, a smile goes a long way. Never lowball so aggressively that it becomes offensive — aim for a fair price that works for both parties. Pack souvenirs carefully in your luggage, using clothes as padding to avoid breakage.

day_by_day.morning: Last full day — enjoy a slow morning at the beach. Take a final sunrise swim and sit on the beach with a coffee, reflecting on the trip. Collect any remaining items from the room and do a final check of belongings. Return any rented equipment (bikes, snorkel gear).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit any remaining local attractions you missed during the trip. Take a final scooter or bicycle ride along the coast. Visit a local café for a leisurely lunch and review your favorite memories. Take final photos of the resort, beach, and surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at your favorite restaurant from the trip. Splurge slightly on a nicer meal to celebrate a successful budget trip to Thailand. Order dishes you loved most during your stay. After dinner, pack your bags completely and prepare for checkout and departure.

meals.breakfast: Favorite breakfast from the trip: revisit the best street food stall you found (~80-100 THB)
meals.lunch: Relaxed cafe lunch: Thai iced tea, pad thai, and a dessert (~120-160 THB)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at your trip favorite: 3-4 dishes, dessert, and a celebratory drink (~250-350 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Double-check your flight details for the return journey. Confirm airport transfer arrangements. Use up remaining Thai Baht on food, drinks, and last-minute souvenirs — exchanging small amounts back to your home currency is often not worth the fees. Keep ~500 THB for transport to the airport.

day_by_day.morning: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrange airport transfer — take a local bus or shared minivan to the airport for the cheapest option (~100-300 THB depending on distance). Arrive at the airport at least 2-3 hours before your flight for international departures.
day_by_day.afternoon: Clear check-in, immigration, and security at the airport. Browse duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts (Thai tea, snacks, or cosmetics can be good value). Grab a final Thai meal at the airport food court — still cheaper than most international airport food.
day_by_day.evening: Board your return flight. Reflect on 13 incredible days in Thailand — the beaches, the islands, the street food, and the warm Thai hospitality. Review your budget totals and plan your next adventure!

meals.breakfast: Final Thai breakfast before checkout: khao tom (rice soup) or fresh fruit (~70-100 THB)
meals.lunch: Airport food court: Thai noodles or rice dish (~120-180 THB)
meals.dinner: Airport or in-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Budget summary tip: A 13-day budget trip to Thailand can be done for approximately 15,000-22,000 THB (~$420-620 USD) excluding flights, covering accommodation, food, activities, and transport within Thailand. Keep your travel insurance documents handy until you're safely home. Kob khun krap/ka — Thank you Thailand!

trip_options.title: Classic Thailand Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and arrange private transfer or airport taxi to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and settle into your beachfront room.

meals.breakfast: N/A - in transit
meals.lunch: N/A - in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a late-night snack at the airport's food court (Try boat noodles or pad kra pao) or order room service upon arrival at the resort.

day_by_day.notes: Keep arrival night light. Exchange some currency at the airport (THB) for convenience. Download Grab app for easy transport throughout the trip. Confirm resort transfer in advance if possible.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Take a slow morning walk along the beachfront to get your bearings and soak in the surroundings of your base location.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the nearest local beach and town area on foot or by rented scooter. Visit a local market or beachside shops to pick up essentials. Take a refreshing swim at the resort beach.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the beach promenade as the sun sets. Explore nearby street food stalls and night market for your first authentic Thai street food experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet included or nearby café offering Thai-style breakfast with congee, fried egg, and fresh fruit.
meals.lunch: Local beachside restaurant - try Pad Thai or Tom Yum soup (approx. 80-150 THB).
meals.dinner: Night market street food crawl - sample mango sticky rice, grilled satay skewers, and som tum papaya salad (budget 200-300 THB total).

day_by_day.notes: This is your orientation day. Get a local SIM card at a nearby convenience store (7-Eleven or Family Mart) for affordable data throughout the trip. Rent a scooter (approx. 200-300 THB/day) for easy local exploration.

day_by_day.morning: Join a half-day snorkeling tour departing from the local pier. Explore vibrant coral reefs and marine life in the surrounding waters. Most tours include equipment and a guide (approx. 600-900 THB per person).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from snorkeling by midday. Relax on the beach, enjoy the resort pool, or take a kayak out from the resort for a gentle paddle along the coastline.
day_by_day.evening: Head into town for a traditional Thai massage at a reputable local spa (60-90 min, approx. 300-500 THB). Afterward, enjoy dinner at a beachfront restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Café near the pier - toast with coconut jam, fresh tropical fruit smoothie.
meals.lunch: Beachside shack lunch post-snorkeling - grilled fish with steamed rice and spicy dipping sauce (approx. 150-200 THB).
meals.dinner: Beachfront seafood restaurant - whole grilled barramundi with garlic and herbs, jasmine rice, and fresh coconut water (approx. 350-500 THB).

day_by_day.notes: October can bring occasional rain showers in Thailand. Check weather before booking water activities. Bring reef-safe sunscreen to protect marine ecosystems.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning island hopping day trip. Depart by speedboat to visit 2-3 nearby smaller islands. Enjoy pristine beaches, clear waters, and photo opportunities at each stop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island hopping tour with a stop at a secluded bay for swimming and snorkeling. Most full-day tours include a buffet lunch on board or at a beach restaurant.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and explore a different section of the local night market or a popular local street food area you haven't visited yet.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort or grab fresh fruit and roti from a street vendor near the pier.
meals.lunch: Included in island hopping tour - Thai buffet with rice, curries, and fresh fruit, OR beachside BBQ at one of the island stops.
meals.dinner: Local restaurant in town - try Massaman curry with roti bread and a Chang beer (approx. 250-350 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Book island hopping tours the day before through your resort or a local tour operator. Prices range from 1,200-2,000 THB per person for a full-day speedboat tour. Bring waterproof bag for valuables.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a local temple or cultural landmark near your resort area. Dress respectfully (cover shoulders and knees). Learn about Thai Buddhist culture and take in the ornate architecture and serene atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a local fresh market (talat sot) in the afternoon. Sample tropical fruits like rambutan, mangosteen, and dragon fruit. Browse local handicrafts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Take a sunset boat cruise along the coast. Many operators offer 2-hour sunset cruises with drinks included (approx. 800-1,200 THB). Watch the sky turn golden over the Andaman Sea or Gulf of Thailand.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local coffee shop - Thai iced coffee (oliang) with banana pancakes.
meals.lunch: Market lunch - fresh spring rolls, grilled corn, and coconut ice cream from market stalls (approx. 100-150 THB).
meals.dinner: Upscale-casual Thai restaurant - green curry with jasmine rice, tom kha gai soup, and fresh lime soda (approx. 400-600 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: When visiting temples, sarongs are often available to borrow at the entrance if needed. Remove shoes before entering temple buildings. Be respectful of worshippers.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day to a nearby major island destination (e.g., Koh Samui, Koh Phi Phi, or Koh Lanta depending on your base). Take a ferry or speedboat transfer in the morning. Check into a mid-range guesthouse or hotel near the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Settle in and explore your new island on foot or by rented scooter. Find the main beach, grab a cold drink, and scope out the local vibe and dining options for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Join the local beach bar scene at sunset. Many islands have iconic beach bars with fire shows and live music. Enjoy cocktails and socialize with fellow travelers.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at resort before departure - toast, eggs, and fresh juice.
meals.lunch: Ferry terminal food stall or convenience store snacks during transit, OR first meal on the new island at a casual beachside café.
meals.dinner: New island's famous street food area or night bazaar - try local specialties like crab fried rice, pad see ew, or fresh seafood BBQ (approx. 200-350 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Ferry schedules vary by season - book tickets in advance online or through your resort. October weather may affect ferry schedules, so have a backup plan. Keep luggage manageable for easy island transfers.

day_by_day.morning: Rent a scooter and explore the island independently. Visit viewpoints, hidden beaches, and local villages. Stop at a quiet beach away from the tourist crowds for a peaceful morning swim.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a half-day kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) session offered by local operators on the beach. Explore sea caves, lagoons, or mangroves by kayak (approx. 400-700 THB).
day_by_day.evening: Find a beachfront restaurant for dinner as the sun sets. Enjoy the relaxed island atmosphere with fresh seafood and local Thai dishes.

meals.breakfast: Local bakery or café - fresh croissant, fruit bowl, and Thai iced tea.
meals.lunch: Beachside restaurant mid-tour break - coconut soup, spring rolls, and fresh coconut water (approx. 150-250 THB).
meals.dinner: Romantic beachfront dinner - grilled tiger prawns, steamed sea bass with lime and chili, and sticky rice (approx. 400-600 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Wear a helmet when riding a scooter - it is required by law and important for safety. Fill up the scooter tank before heading to remote areas as petrol stations can be sparse on smaller islands.

day_by_day.morning: Take a full-day boat tour to explore the island's surrounding smaller islands and snorkeling spots. Visit famous landmarks like Phi Phi Leh's Maya Bay (if applicable) or similar iconic spots in your area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the boat tour with a stop at a pristine snorkeling reef. Swim alongside colorful fish and coral formations. Enjoy a packed lunch on the boat or at a beach.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the island by late afternoon. Treat yourself to a traditional Thai herbal steam and massage at a local wellness center (approx. 400-600 THB for 90 min).

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before departure - banana, granola bar, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Included in boat tour or beach BBQ at one of the island stops - grilled chicken, rice, and fresh fruit.
meals.dinner: Popular local restaurant recommended by guesthouse staff - try khao pad (Thai fried rice), larb salad, and fresh watermelon juice (approx. 200-300 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Some popular spots like Maya Bay have visitor caps and timed entry systems. Book tours that include proper permits. Bring motion sickness tablets if you are sensitive to boat movement.

day_by_day.morning: Explore a different part of the island - visit a local fishing village, a rubber plantation, or a jungle waterfall trail (if available). Hire a local guide for a more authentic experience (approx. 500-800 THB).
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax afternoon at the beach. Try parasailing or jet skiing if weather permits (approx. 500-800 THB). Alternatively, find a hammock under a palm tree and read a book.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Thai cooking class offered by a local restaurant or cooking school. Learn to make 3-4 dishes including a curry, soup, and dessert. Take the recipes home as a souvenir (approx. 900-1,400 THB).

meals.breakfast: Local market breakfast - fresh-squeezed orange juice, fried dough sticks (patongko) with condensed milk, and hard-boiled eggs.
meals.lunch: Casual island café - avocado toast, fresh fruit smoothie bowl, or Thai-style chicken wrap (approx. 150-250 THB).
meals.dinner: Eat what you cooked in the cooking class! Most classes include dining on your creations as part of the experience.

day_by_day.notes: Thai cooking classes are one of the most memorable travel experiences. Book in advance as popular classes fill up quickly. You'll learn dishes like green curry, pad Thai, and mango sticky rice.

day_by_day.morning: Travel back to your main resort base (Aegean Bliss Resort) via ferry or speedboat. Enjoy the scenic sea journey and arrive refreshed. Check back in and unpack.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a relaxed afternoon at the resort. Use the pool, spa facilities, or simply lounge on the beachfront. Catch up on rest after several active days of island exploration.
day_by_day.evening: Revisit your favorite street food spots from the first few days. Try any dishes you missed earlier. Pick up some local snacks and treats to bring home as edible souvenirs.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast or café near the ferry terminal before departure.
meals.lunch: Ferry snack or quick bite upon arrival back at base - green mango salad, grilled chicken skewers from a street vendor.
meals.dinner: Favorite local restaurant from earlier in the trip - enjoy familiar flavors and perhaps order a dish you haven't tried yet (approx. 250-400 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Use this transition day to do laundry (many guesthouses offer laundry service for approx. 50-80 THB/kg), repack, and organize purchases. Confirm any remaining bookings for the last few days.

day_by_day.morning: Take a sunrise beach walk or gentle yoga session on the beach if offered by the resort. Enjoy the peaceful early morning atmosphere before the beach gets busy. Collect shells or simply meditate by the water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby national park or nature reserve for a half-day guided nature walk or boat tour through mangroves. Learn about local flora and fauna from a knowledgeable guide (approx. 600-1,000 THB).
day_by_day.evening: Splurge slightly on a nicer dinner at an upscale beachfront restaurant to celebrate a great trip. Order fresh lobster or whole grilled fish with Thai herbs and spices.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast - full spread including Thai congee, fresh tropical fruit, eggs, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Picnic-style lunch during nature tour or casual café post-tour - tom kha soup and jasmine rice (approx. 150-200 THB).
meals.dinner: Upscale beachfront restaurant - seafood platter, green papaya salad, and sticky rice with mango dessert (approx. 600-900 THB per person with drinks).

day_by_day.notes: October is peak wet season in some parts of Thailand. Nature walks may be muddy - wear appropriate footwear. Mangrove tours are typically unaffected by rain and can be quite magical in misty conditions.

day_by_day.morning: Final full beach day - spend the morning swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying the resort's beachfront facilities. Try any water sport you haven't done yet - windsurfing, banana boat, or paddleboarding.
day_by_day.afternoon: Do any last-minute souvenir shopping at local markets or shops. Look for Thai silk scarves, handmade jewelry, local spices, coconut products, and artisan crafts. Bargaining is acceptable at markets.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a special restaurant. Choose a rooftop or beachfront venue with atmosphere. Reflect on the journey and enjoy your last Thai meal in style.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast or trendy café - açaí bowl, fresh coconut, and Thai iced coffee.
meals.lunch: Beach club lunch - fish tacos, fresh salad, and a tropical cocktail or mocktail (approx. 300-450 THB).
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at a celebrated local restaurant - chef's tasting menu or signature Thai dishes like Panang curry, seafood tom yum, and coconut ice cream (approx. 500-800 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Start packing tonight to avoid a rushed morning. Keep one outfit accessible for travel day. Check airline baggage allowance - Thai markets can lead to overpacking! Vacuum bags are useful.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Take one last walk on the beach at sunrise to say goodbye to the sea. Enjoy a relaxed final breakfast at the resort. Check out by the designated time and store luggage with the concierge if your flight is later.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure time, either explore a final nearby attraction, visit a local café for a last Thai iced tea, or head to the airport. Allow plenty of time for the drive to the airport and check-in procedures.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Thailand with incredible memories of beaches, island adventures, and unforgettable street food. Browse duty-free shops for last-minute gifts - Thai green curry paste sets and coconut candy make great gifts.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast - go all out with a full spread and savor every bite.
meals.lunch: Airport food court or a final street food meal near the resort before transfer - pad kra pao (basil stir fry) with a fried egg over rice, a classic Thai comfort dish (approx. 80-120 THB).
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or in-flight meal depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the airport at least 2.5-3 hours before international departure. Declare any food items being brought back home according to your country's customs regulations. Keep receipts for VAT refund claims on purchases over 2,000 THB from registered shops.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Thailand Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. A private luxury transfer will be waiting to escort you to Aegean Bliss Resort. Upon check-in, enjoy a welcome drink and a brief resort orientation. Settle into your beachfront suite and unwind on your private terrace listening to the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: Light late-night welcome amenity provided by the resort — seasonal fruits, artisan chocolates, and herbal teas arranged in your suite upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private airport transfer in advance through the resort's concierge. Keep luggage light for carry-on to speed through arrival. October in Thailand falls in the tail end of the rainy season in some regions, so expect occasional showers — pack a light rain jacket.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort's beachfront restaurant. Take a gentle orientation walk along the private beach, get acquainted with the resort's amenities including the infinity pool, spa, and water sports center. Meet with the resort concierge to finalize upcoming excursions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's private beach. Arrange a paddleboard or kayak session through the resort's water sports center. Explore the immediate coastal area and take a dip in the warm Andaman or Gulf waters. Optionally book a 60-minute traditional Thai massage at the resort spa to ease jet lag.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar. Enjoy a curated tasting menu dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant, featuring locally sourced seafood and contemporary Thai cuisine with panoramic ocean views.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort beachfront restaurant — full Thai and international buffet with made-to-order eggs, fresh tropical fruits, and premium coffee
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach club — grilled tiger prawns, som tum papaya salad, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Resort signature restaurant — 5-course tasting menu featuring whole steamed sea bass, lobster bisque, and mango sticky rice dessert paired with curated Thai wines

day_by_day.notes: This is a recovery and orientation day. Do not over-schedule. Confirm all upcoming island-hopping and excursion bookings with the concierge today to secure private boats and guides.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning private longtail boat excursion to a nearby uninhabited island or hidden cove accessible only by sea. Snorkel in crystal-clear waters teeming with tropical fish and coral. Your private guide will provide premium snorkeling gear and a chilled refreshment basket.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a beachside lunch. In the afternoon, explore the nearest coastal village or fishing community by private tuk-tuk or resort bicycle. Discover local life, browse artisan stalls, and photograph colorful longtail boats in the harbor.
day_by_day.evening: Join a premium street food tour led by a local culinary guide in the nearest town or night market. Sample pad kra pao, moo ping (grilled pork skewers), fresh oysters, and mango with sticky rice from curated top-rated stalls. The guide ensures hygiene standards meet premium expectations.

meals.breakfast: Resort restaurant — light continental with fresh-pressed juices and Thai-style congee
meals.lunch: Beachside resort grill — grilled barracuda, coconut curry soup, and watermelon granita
meals.dinner: Guided premium street food tour at the local night market — curated 8–10 dish tasting experience across multiple top-rated vendors

day_by_day.notes: Book the private boat excursion the day before through the concierge. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and a dry bag for valuables. The street food tour typically runs 18:30–21:00.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day island hopping adventure via private speedboat. First stop: a famous emerald cave or sea cave accessible only at low tide by swimming through a dark tunnel into a hidden lagoon (location varies by resort region — e.g., Morakot Cave if near Trang, or similar). Snorkel and swim in pristine waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue island hopping to a second island featuring a white sand beach with turquoise shallows. Enjoy a gourmet picnic lunch prepared by the resort chef and served on the beach with chilled rosé. Explore the island on foot, finding viewpoints and secluded coves.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a romantic sunset dinner on your private terrace or a candlelit beach dinner arranged by the resort. Fresh-caught seafood barbecue with Thai herb marinades.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast — energy-boosting smoothie bowls, eggs, and Thai iced coffee
meals.lunch: Gourmet beach picnic by resort chef — charcuterie, grilled lobster rolls, tropical fruit platters, and sparkling water or wine
meals.dinner: Private candlelit beach barbecue at the resort — whole grilled red snapper, tiger prawns, and sticky rice with premium local beers or wine

day_by_day.notes: Full-day speedboat charter typically costs $300–$600 USD for a private boat. Depart early (around 08:00) to beat crowds at popular caves and beaches. Bring motion sickness tablets if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or Muay Thai introductory class on the beach offered by the resort. Followed by a Thai herbal compress massage at the resort spa — a deeply relaxing treatment using warm bundles of lemongrass, kaffir lime, and ginger.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a nearby coastal town's floating market or local pier market by private transfer. Shop for handmade crafts, silk scarves, and local spices. Visit a nearby Buddhist temple or shrine for cultural context and beautiful photo opportunities.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a premium cocktail-making class at the resort bar, learning to craft Thai-inspired cocktails using lemongrass-infused gin, butterfly pea flower, and fresh lime. Followed by dinner at the resort's second dining venue featuring Northern Thai cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Resort — acai bowls, fresh papaya, and eggs Benedict with smoked salmon
meals.lunch: Local floating market or pier market — fresh steamed dumplings, grilled corn, coconut ice cream, and freshly squeezed sugarcane juice
meals.dinner: Resort's Northern Thai restaurant — khao soi (coconut curry noodles), sai ua (Northern Thai sausage), and nam prik ong with premium Thai craft beer

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered) when visiting temples. The floating market is typically most vibrant in the morning — adjust timing if visiting. Cocktail class is usually complimentary for resort guests or available for a small fee.

day_by_day.morning: Private chartered longtail boat tour to a marine national park or protected island cluster nearby. Snorkel over pristine coral gardens with a certified marine biologist guide who narrates the ecosystem. Spot parrotfish, sea turtles, and reef sharks in their natural habitat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at a secluded island beach for a free afternoon of swimming, sunbathing, and beachcombing. The boat captain will prepare a fresh Thai seafood lunch on the boat using morning catches. Relax in the shade of palm trees and enjoy complete seclusion.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort. Evening at leisure — enjoy the resort's infinity pool at sunset with a cocktail. Light dinner at the resort's casual beach bar featuring premium small plates and fresh sashimi.

meals.breakfast: Resort — Thai-style breakfast with jok (rice porridge), fried eggs, and Thai milk tea
meals.lunch: Freshly prepared on-boat Thai seafood — steamed clams with lemongrass, grilled fish with chili-lime sauce, and sticky rice
meals.dinner: Resort beach bar — yellowfin tuna sashimi, wagyu beef sliders, truffle fries, and fresh coconut cocktails

day_by_day.notes: National park entry fees apply (typically 200–500 THB per person). Confirm marine park permit is included in the boat charter. Avoid touching coral or marine life during snorkeling.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to a larger nearby island by high-speed ferry or private speedboat. Upon arrival, hire a private scooter driver or tuk-tuk for the day to explore the island's highlights — viewpoints, temples, and hidden beaches not found in tourist guides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the island's most famous or scenic beach in the early afternoon before crowds peak. Enjoy lunch at a highly regarded beachfront restaurant on the island. Explore the island's main town, visiting a local market and sampling street food snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the island's famous beach club or sunset bar scene — a hallmark of premium Thailand travel. Enjoy sundowners with live acoustic music. Return to the resort by private speedboat under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Resort — full buffet with made-to-order waffles and tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Renowned beachfront restaurant on the island — fresh crab fried rice, tom kha gai (coconut chicken soup), and fresh lime sorbet
meals.dinner: Island beach club — tapas-style sharing plates, premium cocktails, and live music; or return to resort for a late dinner at the signature restaurant

day_by_day.notes: Research the specific island accessible from your resort's region (e.g., Koh Lanta, Koh Phi Phi, Koh Samui, or Koh Tao depending on resort location). Book speedboat return in advance to ensure availability for evening return.

day_by_day.morning: Indulgent rest morning. Sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed or on your private terrace. Book a full 90-minute aromatherapy spa treatment at the resort — combining traditional Thai massage with hot oil and floral bath. This is a mid-trip rejuvenation day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a private Thai cooking class at the resort or at a nearby cooking school. Learn to prepare 4–5 classic Thai dishes including tom yum soup, green curry, pad thai, and mango sticky rice. Take home a handwritten recipe card.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the fruits of your cooking class as part of a communal dinner with your instructor and fellow travelers, or dine privately with your prepared dishes on the resort terrace. Pair with a bottle of fine Riesling or a premium Thai craft beer.

meals.breakfast: In-room dining — French press coffee, eggs your way, fresh-baked croissants, and tropical fruit platter
meals.lunch: Light resort poolside snack — spring rolls, fresh fruit, and iced lemongrass tea
meals.dinner: Your own Thai cooking class creations — tom yum goong, green curry with jasmine rice, and mango sticky rice for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Thai cooking classes typically last 3–4 hours including a market visit to source ingredients. Book at least 2 days in advance. This is an excellent mid-trip activity to deepen cultural engagement without physical exertion.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise kayaking excursion through mangrove tunnels and sea caves along the coastline. A private guide leads the way through narrow channels teeming with wildlife — monitor lizards, kingfishers, and mudskippers. A unique and serene experience best done at low tide.
day_by_day.afternoon: After returning and showering, take a private transfer to a nearby town for an immersive street food lunch experience — exploring local markets independently with a curated map provided by the resort concierge. Visit a local wet market to see exotic produce and fresh seafood.
day_by_day.evening: Premium waterfront dinner at one of the region's top-rated independent restaurants (not resort-based). Enjoy a chef's tasting menu showcasing the finest local ingredients — blue swimmer crab, Andaman lobster, and jasmine-scented desserts. Reserve in advance.

meals.breakfast: Pre-excursion light resort breakfast — energy bars, bananas, and strong Thai coffee
meals.lunch: Local town street food exploration — boat noodles, roti with massaman curry dip, fresh-squeezed orange juice, and Thai iced tea
meals.dinner: Top-rated local fine-dining restaurant — 7-course chef's tasting menu with wine pairing featuring regional seafood and contemporary Thai techniques

day_by_day.notes: Mangrove kayaking is best at low tide — check tide tables with the concierge. Wear quick-dry clothing and water shoes. The fine-dining restaurant reservation should be made 2–3 days in advance as top venues fill quickly.

day_by_day.morning: Private boat excursion to a limestone karst island cluster (similar to Phang Nga Bay-style scenery). Explore towering karst formations rising from the sea, paddle through sea caves by canoe, and stop at a floating Muslim fishing village for a cultural encounter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Anchor at a secluded bay for afternoon swimming and snorkeling. Enjoy a catered Thai lunch on the boat with cold beverages. Photograph the dramatic karst scenery and turquoise waters. Return to resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Thai cultural performance — classical dance, shadow puppetry, or Muay Thai exhibition — arranged by the resort or at a local cultural center. Follow with a casual dinner at the resort's beach bar.

meals.breakfast: Resort — Thai omelet with jasmine rice, fresh papaya, and iced coffee
meals.lunch: On-boat catered lunch — Thai green curry, coconut rice, fresh pineapple, and chilled water
meals.dinner: Resort beach bar — massaman lamb curry, roti bread, and Thai coconut pudding with a glass of Sauvignon Blanc

day_by_day.notes: The floating village visit is a culturally sensitive experience — dress modestly and ask permission before photographing residents. Bring cash for purchasing handmade souvenirs directly from villagers.

day_by_day.morning: Final major island-hopping adventure — a full-day private speedboat charter to visit 3 different islands in one day. Start with the most photogenic beach, move to a snorkeling hotspot, and finish at a beach known for its dramatic sunset views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at the third island — relax on the beach, swim, and enjoy a gourmet picnic. Explore any beachside stalls or local restaurants for supplementary snacks. Take in the natural beauty and reflect on the trip.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from the boat on the return journey — champagne or sparkling wine on deck as the sun dips below the horizon over the Andaman Sea or Gulf of Thailand. Return to resort for a relaxed farewell-style dinner.

meals.breakfast: Resort — açai bowls, granola, smoked salmon bagels, and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Gourmet beach picnic — cold-cut charcuterie, grilled shrimp skewers, fresh fruit, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Resort signature restaurant — premium farewell dinner with whole grilled lobster, Thai herb salad, and lychee panna cotta with champagne toast

day_by_day.notes: This is the premium highlight day of island hopping — invest in the best private charter available. Request champagne on the boat in advance. Consider bringing a waterproof camera or GoPro for underwater shots.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely last full morning at the resort. Enjoy a long breakfast and a final swim in the ocean or infinity pool. Pack non-essentials and begin organizing luggage. Take a final beach walk to collect memories and last photographs of the resort's surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final street food adventure — take a private transfer to the best local street food area or night market in the region for a last immersive culinary experience. Eat freely and indulge in all the dishes you haven't yet tried — pad see ew, khao man gai, fresh coconut ice cream.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a final sunset cocktail at the overwater bar. Enjoy a special farewell dinner arranged by the resort — personalized menu based on your favorite dishes from the trip. Exchange contacts with resort staff and collect any purchased souvenirs or gifts.

meals.breakfast: Resort — full indulgent buffet, made-to-order pancakes, and premium coffee
meals.lunch: Street food market — unlimited tasting: pad see ew, fried oyster omelets, mango sticky rice, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Resort personalized farewell dinner — curated from your trip favorites, served on the beach with torchlight ambiance and a bottle of premium wine

day_by_day.notes: Confirm departure transfer time with the concierge today. Leave a review or tip for exceptional resort staff. Purchase any last-minute gifts — Thai silk, artisan spices, or handcrafted jewelry — during the street food outing.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy a last leisurely breakfast overlooking the ocean. Complete packing and check out of the suite. Store luggage with the concierge if your departure is in the afternoon or evening. Take a final dip or simply sit on the beach in quiet reflection.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time, enjoy a final spa treatment — a 45-minute express Thai massage to prepare for the long journey home. Collect luggage and board your private luxury transfer to the airport arranged by the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Thailand with unforgettable memories. At the airport, enjoy the premium lounge if available with your airline class. Reflect on 13 days of beaches, island hopping, and extraordinary street food across one of the world's most beautiful destinations.

meals.breakfast: Resort — final breakfast with all your favorites: Thai iced coffee, tropical fruits, eggs, and fresh-baked pastries
meals.lunch: Airport premium lounge or a light meal at a well-regarded airport restaurant — tom kha soup, spring rolls, and fresh fruit
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or airport lounge dinner — request special meal if available through your airline

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 12:00 — arrange late checkout if possible for an extra fee. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. Keep all receipts for customs declaration if purchasing high-value goods. Ensure all travel documents, souvenirs, and medications are packed in carry-on.

query: Thailand beaches, $1800 for couple, mix of island hopping and street food, October 2026
